hero.headline: Bathroom and laundry renovations in Wollongong, designed and finished properly.
hero.subhead: Full bathroom and laundry renovations and shower repairs across Wollongong and the Illawarra. Tell us about the room and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Elite Bathrooms assistant. Planning a new bathroom or laundry, or got a shower that's leaking? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: You picture the room. We design it and build it properly.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a bathroom renovation: help with the design and products, a clear price before anything starts, and a tidy site they can keep living around. Every job runs that way, from the first design chat to the final clean.

cards.title: Laundries that don't work

cards.title: Bathrooms that need to be easier to use
cards.body: Accessible bathrooms with walk-in baths, wider spaces and fittings built around mobility.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Tell us about the room and we'll talk it through.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough figure that grows once the old tiles come off.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: The only bathroom in the house out of action for weeks longer than promised.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Dust and rubble through the house while you're still living in it.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a renovator just to get a clear quote.

solutions.headline: Straightforward renovations built around clear communication.

realReviews.author: Lee-Anne McCabe
realReviews.text: We are absolutely delighted with the bathroom and laundry renovation Steve recently completed. He kept us informed every step of the way from the inital design, selecting products and through each stage. He made sure the work site was cleaned up at the end of each day which was important as we remained living in our house during the renovations. The tradies he used were top class and all work was completed to the highest standard. Highly recommend Steve to anyone looking for an experienced, quality bathroom/laundry renovation business.

realReviews.author: carol jackson
realReviews.text:
Steve did the most amazing job for me on my bathroom . He encountered a few issues that were not expected but was able to sort them out in a timely manner . He is neat and very particular and his attention to detail was great .
I highly recommend him .

realReviews.author: Jenny
realReviews.text:
If you  are looking for a renovator who is prompt, professional and meticulous in every way, then this is the business for you.
Steve converted a spare bedroom to an age-friendly, mobility walker accessible bathroom/laundry. He started from scratch with flooring, plumbing, tiling, painting and installed a bidet toilet, walk-in bath, laundry facilities, benchtop and storage.
The team carried out everything to the highest standard. Steve was on-site every single day; cleaned and tidied the site at the end of the day and regularly referred to me for decisions and preferences. He did everything he could to help me improve my lifestyle.
If there were more than 5 stars,  I would happily give them. Thank you, Steve.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your bathroom or laundry?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about your project.

faq.a: Send the project through the form or give us a call. We'll come out to measure, talk through the design and send a written quote that lists the scope and price.
Wollongong and the Illawarra. Tell us your suburb when you get in touch and we'll confirm.

faq.q: Can we stay at home during the renovation?
faq.a: Yes. The site is cleaned up at the end of each day, so you can keep living at home while the work goes on.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the room and book a measure-up.
